nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps external VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3 for all logic. Input VIN_5V is externally supplied; LDO output VCC_3V3 is distributed to MCU, motor driver logic, and current sense amplifier.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 MCU runs on VCC_3V3. It generates PWM on PWMA and direction control via AIN1, AIN2, and standby via STBY to drive the TB6612FNG channel A. ADC input CURRENT_SENSE receives amplified motor current from INA128.

nodes.name: VBAT
nodes.description: Battery backup power supply for RTC, backup registers and LSE oscillator. Connect to VDD if VBAT not used.

nodes.name: PC13
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: TAMPER-RTC, RTC calibration output. Limited drive capability (2MHz max, sinks/sources up to 3mA).

nodes.name: PC14
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate function: OSC32_IN (32.768kHz LSE crystal input). Limited drive capability.

nodes.name: PC15
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate function: OSC32_OUT (32.768kHz LSE crystal output). Limited drive capability.

nodes.name: OSC_IN
nodes.description: HSE oscillator input (4-16MHz crystal). Can be remapped to PD0 GPIO via AFIO_MAPR register.

nodes.name: OSC_OUT
nodes.description: HSE oscillator output (crystal). Can be remapped to PD1 GPIO via AFIO_MAPR register.

nodes.name: NRST
nodes.description: External reset input, active low with internal pull-up. Filter capacitor to GND recommended.

nodes.name: VSSA
nodes.description: Analog ground reference for ADC, PLL, RC oscillators and comparators.

nodes.name: VDDA
nodes.description: Analog power supply 2.0-3.6V (min 2.4V when ADC used). Also serves as VREF+ on LQFP48 package.

nodes.name: PA0
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: WKUP, USART2_CTS, ADC12_IN0, TIM2_CH1_ETR.

nodes.name: PA7

nodes.name: PA15
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), default function: JTDI. Alternate functions: SPI1_NSS (remap), TIM2_CH1_ETR (remap).

nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), default function: JTDO/TRACESWO. Alternate functions: SPI1_SCK (remap), TIM2_CH2 (remap).

nodes.name: BOOT0
nodes.description: Boot mode selection input. Low=boot from Flash, High=boot from System Memory (bootloader) or SRAM depending on BOOT1.

nodes.name: motor_driver
nodes.description: TB6612FNG channel A drives the motor. Receives VCC_3V3 for logic, external VIN_MOTOR for motor supply, and control pins AIN1, AIN2, PWMA, STBY from MCU. Provides low-side motor node MOTOR_SENSE for current shunt placement.

nodes.name: PWMB
nodes.description: Channel B PWM input. 200K internal pull-down.

nodes.name: BIN2
nodes.description: Channel B direction input 2. 200K internal pull-down.

nodes.name: BIN1
nodes.description: Channel B direction input 1. 200K internal pull-down.

nodes.name: STBY
nodes.description: Standby control. HIGH=active, LOW=standby. 200K internal pull-down.

nodes.name: AIN1
nodes.description: Channel A direction input 1. 200K internal pull-down.

nodes.name: AIN2
nodes.description: Channel A direction input 2. 200K internal pull-down.

nodes.name: PWMA
nodes.description: Channel A PWM input. 200K internal pull-down.

nodes.name: current_sense
nodes.description: INA128 instrumentation amplifier powered by VCC_3V3 senses voltage across the low-side shunt. VIN_P connects to MOTOR_SENSE node, VIN_N is tied to GND. Amplified output VOUT is routed to MCU ADC input CURRENT_SENSE.

nodes.name: RG_1
nodes.description: Gain setting pin 1. Connect RG between pin 1 and pin 8. G = 1 + 50K/RG.

nodes.name: V_NEG
nodes.description: Negative supply (or GND for single-supply operation).

nodes.name: REF
nodes.description: Output reference. VOUT = G*(VIN_P - VIN_N) + VREF. Low impedance source required.

nodes.name: RG_2
nodes.description: Gain setting pin 2. Connect RG between pin 1 and pin 8.
